card.name: Space before a year in statistics
card.fires_on: Strongest on the space token just before a four-digit year after 'in', and weaker on a comma after a year or statistic in citations. Other hits are scattered words in web text.

modes.label: Space before year
modes.description: The bare space token right before a year such as 2003 or 2010 in statistical or citation text.
modes.example: Million Homeschooled Students in the United States in<< >>2003 Until 1

modes.label: Comma after date or figure
modes.description: A comma following a year or worldwide figure, just before a count is given.
modes.example: The U.S. Bureau of Justice estimated that as of 2008<<,>> there were over 846,

modes.label: Scattered web words
modes.description: Single ordinary words in headlines or event text with no shared theme.
